_meta.description: The log2timeline (Plaso) lane model: the recursive or free-form trees that would otherwise explode the field count are mapped flattened so each costs one mapper whatever its keys — pathspec (the nested storage-media path), date_time (Plaso's DateTimeValues object) and values (a winreg value whose data is a string in one record and an object in the next). Plaso's windows:evtx:record data_type is normalised onto the shared logs-dxdfir@winlog model by the winevtx submodule, so its System and EventData fields do not live here.
